description.value: Datadog, Inc. is a U.S. software company that provides observability services for cloud-scale applications.
Datadog, Inc. is an American company that provides an observability service for cloud-scale applications.
Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era.
Datadog sells a cloud monitoring and security platform.
Describes itself in its FY2024 10-K as the observability and security platform for cloud applications.

product_description.value: Offerings are grouped under Observability, Security, Digital Experience, Software Delivery, Service Management and AI, including Infrastructure Monitoring, APM, Log Management and Cloud SIEM.
Observability (infrastructure, application performance, data and log monitoring), Security (code, cloud and SIEM), Digital Experience, Software Delivery, Service Management and AI agents (Bits AI).
Infrastructure monitoring, network performance and device monitoring, serverless monitoring and cloud cost management, with over 750 integrations.
A SaaS data analytics platform for monitoring servers, databases, tools and services, including infrastructure, network, serverless monitoring and cloud cost management.
SaaS platform spanning infrastructure monitoring, APM, log management, user experience monitoring, cloud security and software delivery.

business_model_description.value: Revenue comes from subscriptions to its cloud-based platform, sold in Pro and Enterprise tiers, with a land-and-expand model; professional services are immaterial.
